key.name: refresh-interval
key.description: Seconds between refreshes of the local token usage (30-3600).

key.name: plan-refresh-interval
key.description: Seconds between requests to Anthropic for the plan percentages (60-3600). The endpoint rate-limits frequent requests.

key.name: language
key.description: 'it' or 'en'. Empty = not chosen yet: Italian if the desktop language is Italian, English otherwise.

key.name: bar-color-mode
key.description: 'accent': system accent colour; 'traffic': green/yellow/red according to the thresholds.

key.name: warn-threshold
key.description: Usage percentage above which the indicator turns yellow.

key.name: critical-threshold
key.description: Usage percentage above which the indicator turns red.

key.name: panel-show-five-hour
key.description: Show the 5-hour window usage ring in the top bar.

key.name: panel-show-seven-day
key.description: Show the weekly usage ring in the top bar.

key.name: crabs-enabled
key.description: Show a crab (Clawd) in the top bar for each open Claude Code session.

key.name: panel-empty
key.description: 'crab': a sleeping crab next to the rings; 'icon': the extension icon.

key.name: crab-max
key.description: Maximum number of crabs shown; the other sessions are counted in "+N".

key.name: crab-overflow
key.description: What to do when the panel has less room than the animations need: 'overflow' draws them above the box, 'crop' cuts the top rows.

key.name: panel-content-height
key.description: Pixels available for the crabs in the top bar, measured and written by the extension (0 = not measured yet).
